title: 鐵路時刻表衝突消解~Railway timetable conflict resolution
focus: 資源占用與延誤傳播的時刻衝突消解~Timetable conflict resolution through resource occupation and delay propagation
summary: 本課聚焦資源占用與延誤傳播的時刻衝突消解。從區間占用時間建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把折返資源利用率與衝突優先權狀態連成可驗證的介面，最後以穩健時刻證據限制整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。~This course studies timetable conflict resolution through resource occupation and delay propagation. Start with open-line occupation time to define physical or information boundaries, connect utilization of reversal resources with conflict-priority states as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through evidence limits for robust timetables. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
history: 本課以可查核的工程與方法出版歷程建立背景：2002 年鐵路可靠度與安全方法早期版發布。；2023 年歐盟列控技術規則二零二三號一六九五發布。；2025 年鐵路可靠度與安全方法第一分冊發布。這些日期分別是工程事件、指南重印或標準研究出版，並非宣稱本課系統在該年問世。對資源占用與延誤傳播的時刻衝突消解而言，歷史脈絡的價值是理解需求如何從單一設備擴展到跨介面證據。本課再用交會緩衝分配及時刻重播工作量連結這些方法；代表工程僅提供觀察方向，假想參數不冒充現場資料，歷史版規範也不自動等於當地現行要求。~The background uses checkable project events and methodological publication history. 2002: An early railway RAMS specification was published. 2023: European Commission Regulation twenty-twenty-three slash sixteen-ninety-five was adopted. 2025: A new first part of railway RAMS was published. These dates identify project events, guide reprints, or standards and research publications, rather than claiming that the lesson system first appeared then. For timetable conflict resolution through resource occupation and delay propagation, the useful historical perspective is the expansion from individual equipment to evidence across interfaces. The course connects that perspective through allocating crossing buffers and timetable-replay effort. Reference projects guide observation only: hypothetical parameters are not field data, and historical editions do not automatically establish current local requirements.
example: 原創整合工作單，所有輸入均為教學假設而非代表工程實測：先研究區間占用時間。原創假想教學輸入：列車占用長度 L=180 m；假想防護距離 S=420 m；等速速度 v=15 m/s；附加處理時間 td=20 s。公式 y=(L+S)/v+td，代入得 y=60 s。邊界：等速單一資源的概念下界，不是任何號誌系統的實際最小班距。敏感度只改 S=420 至 462 m，輸出變為 62.8 s；離散計數採整數變化。再獨立研究交會緩衝分配：原創假想教學輸入：排定間隔 scheduled=140 s；資源占用 occupied=110 s；入侵延誤 delay=18 s。公式 y=scheduled-occupied-delay，代入得 y=12 s。邊界：單一衝突資源與確定延誤，未求解整個網路的隨機時刻最佳化。兩個結果不能因同一課程就任意相加，必須先確認單位、因果順序及共同邊界。本單元先將車長與防護間隔轉成時間，再比較不同區間的占用以找出最限制排程的資源。最後提出一項量測能區分模型假設失效與儀器偏差，將輸入表、重算結果和適用限制一併交付。~Original integrated worksheet; every input is a teaching assumption rather than a measurement from a reference project. First investigate open-line occupation time. Original hypothetical teaching inputs: occupied train length L=180 m; hypothetical protected distance S=420 m; constant speed v=15 m/s; additional processing time td=20 s. Formula y=(L+S)/v+td gives y=60 s. Boundary: Conceptual lower bound for one resource at constant speed, not an operating minimum for any signalling system. For sensitivity, change only S=420 to 462 m; the output becomes 62.8 s. Discrete counts use whole-number steps. Independently investigate allocating crossing buffers: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: scheduled interval scheduled=140 s; resource occupation occupied=110 s; incoming delay delay=18 s. Formula y=scheduled-occupied-delay gives y=12 s. Boundary: One conflicting resource and a deterministic delay; no stochastic network-wide timetable optimization is implied. Results cannot be added merely because they belong to the same course: check units, causal sequence and shared boundaries first. Convert train length and protected spacing into time before comparing section occupations to identify the resource most restrictive to scheduling. Propose one measurement distinguishing a failed model assumption from instrument bias, and deliver the input table, recomputed results and applicability limits together.

units.anchor: 區間占用時間~Open-line occupation time
units.title: 區間占用時間~Open-line occupation time
units.mechanism: 本單元先將車長與防護間隔轉成時間，再比較不同區間的占用以找出最限制排程的資源。班距是時間資源問題，不能僅用兩車車頭距離判斷。列車長度、防護距離與釋放時間會共同占用線路；車站停靠、路口衝突或折返可能比區間運轉更先成為瓶頸，所以縮小單一間隔不等於全線增能。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：等速單一資源的概念下界，不是任何號誌系統的實際最小班距。~Convert train length and protected spacing into time before comparing section occupations to identify the resource most restrictive to scheduling. Headway is a time-resource problem, not merely a distance between train fronts. Train length, protected separation and release time occupy the route together. Dwell, conflicting junctions or terminal reversals can dominate capacity before open-line running does, so reducing one interval need not raise line throughput. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Conceptual lower bound for one resource at constant speed, not an operating minimum for any signalling system.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：列車占用長度 L=180 m；假想防護距離 S=420 m；等速速度 v=15 m/s；附加處理時間 td=20 s。公式 y=(L+S)/v+td，代入得 y=60 s。邊界：等速單一資源的概念下界，不是任何號誌系統的實際最小班距。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: occupied train length L=180 m; hypothetical protected distance S=420 m; constant speed v=15 m/s; additional processing time td=20 s. Formula y=(L+S)/v+td gives y=60 s. Boundary: Conceptual lower bound for one resource at constant speed, not an operating minimum for any signalling system.
units.verify: 以時空圖標出車尾清空與資源釋放時刻，再檢查月台、道岔及折返各自的占用。以「區間占用時間」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Mark rear clearance and resource release on a time-distance diagram, then examine platform, point and reversal occupation separately. For open-line occupation time, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 將車頭離站當成月台路徑已清空會低估占用時間，瓶頸轉移則會造成局部改善卻全線延誤。回到「區間占用時間」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Treating front departure as complete route clearance understates occupation; a shifted bottleneck can improve one section while delays persist elsewhere. Trace the input chain for open-line occupation time. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 只要區間最小間距縮短全線運能必定同比提高~Reducing open-line separation always increases whole-line capacity in the same proportion.
units.practice: 只把假想防護距離 S 從 420 改成 462 m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 60 變為 62.8 s。先說明「區間占用時間」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only hypothetical protected distance S from 420 to 462 m (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 60 to 62.8 s. Explain the causal direction for open-line occupation time, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 交會緩衝分配~Allocating crossing buffers
units.title: 交會緩衝分配~Allocating crossing buffers
units.mechanism: 本單元為單線交會配置獨立餘裕，檢查一列車晚到時另一列車的等待如何向後傳播。時刻表餘裕是已排間隔扣除占用與擾動後的剩餘時間。餘裕可以吸收小延誤，卻不是可隨意重複使用的免費容量；同一段緩衝若被兩個衝突約束同時借用，紙面上可行的時刻仍會在實際重播中互相追趕。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：單一衝突資源與確定延誤，未求解整個網路的隨機時刻最佳化。~Assign distinct margins to a single-track meet and examine how one late arrival propagates waiting to the opposing train. Timetable margin is scheduled separation less occupation and perturbation. It can absorb small delays but is not free capacity that may be reused indefinitely. If two conflicting constraints both claim the same buffer, a timetable that appears feasible on paper can still produce converging delays in replay. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: One conflicting resource and a deterministic delay; no stochastic network-wide timetable optimization is implied.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：排定間隔 scheduled=140 s；資源占用 occupied=110 s；入侵延誤 delay=18 s。公式 y=scheduled-occupied-delay，代入得 y=12 s。邊界：單一衝突資源與確定延誤，未求解整個網路的隨機時刻最佳化。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: scheduled interval scheduled=140 s; resource occupation occupied=110 s; incoming delay delay=18 s. Formula y=scheduled-occupied-delay gives y=12 s. Boundary: One conflicting resource and a deterministic delay; no stochastic network-wide timetable optimization is implied.
units.verify: 將每一段餘裕標記唯一用途，逐列重播延誤，檢查負餘裕是否傳到下一個路口。以「交會緩衝分配」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Assign each buffer a unique purpose, replay train delays in sequence, and check whether negative margin propagates to the next junction. For allocating crossing buffers, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 重複計入同一緩衝會掩蓋衝突；把終點補時誤算為上游路口可用時間也會高估穩健度。回到「交會緩衝分配」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Double-counted buffers hide conflicts; recovery time at a terminus cannot automatically be used at an earlier junction. Trace the input chain for allocating crossing buffers. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 同一段時刻餘裕可以同時完整吸收所有列車延誤~The same timetable buffer can fully absorb every train delay simultaneously.
units.practice: 只把入侵延誤 delay 從 18 改成 19.8 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 12 變為 10.2 s。先說明「交會緩衝分配」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only incoming delay delay from 18 to 19.8 s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 12 to 10.2 s. Explain the causal direction for allocating crossing buffers, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 停站變異傳播~Propagation of dwell variability
units.title: 停站變異傳播~Propagation of dwell variability
units.mechanism: 本單元把旅客登車波動轉成停站時間變化，檢查月台服務是否比區間運轉更先控制容量。停站時間包含人流服務與固定開關門程序。各門均分旅客時可用總服務率估算，但熱門樓梯旁的門通常更壅塞；瓶頸門完成時間控制發車，平均流率因此不能保證最忙車門也能按時結束。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：均勻單向登車，沒有下車逆流、行李阻塞或門重開。~Convert boarding variation into dwell-time change and test whether platform service constrains capacity before open-line running does. Dwell includes passenger service and fixed door sequences. Dividing by total service rate assumes an even passenger distribution, yet doors near popular stairs are often more crowded. The busiest door governs completion, so average flow cannot guarantee timely clearance at that door. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Uniform one-way boarding without alighting counterflow, luggage blockage or door reopening.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：登車人數 N=180 persons；有效門數 doors=12 doors；每門流率 rate=0.8 persons/(s*door)；固定程序時間 fixed=12 s。公式 y=N/(doors*rate)+fixed，代入得 y=30.75 s。邊界：均勻單向登車，沒有下車逆流、行李阻塞或門重開。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: boarding passengers N=180 persons; effective doors doors=12 doors; flow per door rate=0.8 persons/(s*door); fixed procedure time fixed=12 s. Formula y=N/(doors*rate)+fixed gives y=30.75 s. Boundary: Uniform one-way boarding without alighting counterflow, luggage blockage or door reopening.
units.verify: 逐門記錄開始與結束時間，將固定程序從人流時間中扣除，再比較最忙門與平均門。以「停站變異傳播」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Record start and finish at each door, subtract fixed procedure time, and compare the busiest door with the mean. For propagation of dwell variability, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 平均人數正常但單門集中仍會延誤；門故障與旅客逆流都可能造成相似的總停站時間。回到「停站變異傳播」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~A normal average load can hide a concentrated door queue; mechanical faults and passenger counterflow can produce similar total dwell. Trace the input chain for propagation of dwell variability. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 總旅客數相同就代表每次停站時間一定相同~Equal total passenger counts always produce equal dwell times.
units.practice: 只把登車人數 N 從 180 改成 181 persons（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 30.75 變為 30.8542 s。先說明「停站變異傳播」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only boarding passengers N from 180 to 181 persons (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 30.75 to 30.8542 s. Explain the causal direction for propagation of dwell variability, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 折返資源利用率~Utilization of reversal resources
units.title: 折返資源利用率~Utilization of reversal resources
units.mechanism: 本單元將折返股道視為有限服務通道，檢查平均需求、尖峰到達與設備中斷的差異。利用率比較需求與服務能力，是穩定性檢查而非等待時間的完整答案。平均需求小於平均容量仍可能出現短暫尖峰與排隊；若排程把所有時段填滿，任何變異都只能向後傳播，缺乏讓系統恢復的空間。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定平均率且單一服務通道；實際批次、優先權與休息中斷須另建模。~Treat reversal tracks as finite service channels and distinguish mean demand, peak arrivals and equipment interruptions. Utilization compares demand with service capacity; it is a stability check rather than a complete waiting-time answer. Mean demand below mean capacity still permits bursts and queues. When every interval is fully occupied, variability propagates downstream because no recovery space remains. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Fixed mean rates and one service channel; batches, priorities and interruptions require separate modelling.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：平均到達率 arrival=8 jobs/h；單通道服務率 service=12 jobs/h。公式 y=arrival/service，代入得 y=0.666667 1。邊界：固定平均率且單一服務通道；實際批次、優先權與休息中斷須另建模。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: mean arrival rate arrival=8 jobs/h; single-channel service rate service=12 jobs/h. Formula y=arrival/service gives y=0.666667 1. Boundary: Fixed mean rates and one service channel; batches, priorities and interruptions require separate modelling.
units.verify: 以不同時間窗統計到達與完成數，檢查平均值是否掩蓋短時過載，並保留未完成工作。以「折返資源利用率」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Count arrivals and completions over several windows, test for hidden bursts, and retain unfinished work in the accounting. For utilization of reversal resources, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 只統計完成案件會漏掉被延後或放棄者，使負荷被低估；設備停機又會降低可用服務率。回到「折返資源利用率」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Counting only completed jobs omits deferred or abandoned demand and understates loading; downtime also reduces available service rate. Trace the input chain for utilization of reversal resources. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 平均利用率低於百分之百就保證完全不會排隊~Mean utilization below one hundred percent guarantees that no queue ever forms.
units.practice: 只把平均到達率 arrival 從 8 改成 8.8 jobs/h（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.666667 變為 0.733333 1。先說明「折返資源利用率」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only mean arrival rate arrival from 8 to 8.8 jobs/h (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.666667 to 0.733333 1. Explain the causal direction for utilization of reversal resources, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 月台旅客積壓~Passenger accumulation at platforms
units.title: 月台旅客積壓~Passenger accumulation at platforms
units.mechanism: 本單元追蹤列車延誤期間旅客流入與離開，將月台存量納入調度代價而不只最小化列車晚點。排隊人數依流入減流出的守恆關係累積。平均服務能力若只略高於平均需求，瞬間車潮仍會形成等待；人群不能被無限壓縮，所以排隊長度會回堵上游樓梯或月台，改變原先假設的到達方式。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定流率、初始無排隊且流入大於流出；不含放棄、繞行及密度回饋。~Track passenger arrivals and departures during a train delay, including platform occupancy in dispatch costs rather than minimizing train lateness alone. A queue accumulates according to inflow minus outflow. Even service capacity slightly above mean demand can be overwhelmed by a train-arrival pulse. People cannot be compressed indefinitely, so a growing queue can block upstream stairs or platforms and alter the assumed arrival process. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant flows, initially empty queue and inflow above outflow; abandonment, rerouting and density feedback are excluded.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：到達流率 arrival=3.2 persons/s；離開流率 service=2.6 persons/s；觀察時間 duration=120 s。公式 y=(arrival-service)*duration，代入得 y=72 persons。邊界：固定流率、初始無排隊且流入大於流出；不含放棄、繞行及密度回饋。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: arrival flow arrival=3.2 persons/s; departure flow service=2.6 persons/s; observation duration duration=120 s. Formula y=(arrival-service)*duration gives y=72 persons. Boundary: Constant flows, initially empty queue and inflow above outflow; abandonment, rerouting and density feedback are excluded.
units.verify: 同時數進入、離開與區內存量，以影像匿名計數或人工抽樣核對人數守恆。以「月台旅客積壓」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Count entries, exits and occupancy together, using anonymous image counts or manual samples to verify conservation. For passenger accumulation at platforms, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 只量出口通過量會看不到後方累積，感測器漏計還可能讓看似平衡的流率掩蓋真實回堵。回到「月台旅客積壓」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Exit throughput alone misses upstream accumulation; missed detections can hide real spillback behind apparently balanced flows. Trace the input chain for passenger accumulation at platforms. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 出口每秒通過人數穩定就能證明站內沒有排隊~Stable exit throughput proves that no queue is forming inside the station.
units.practice: 只把觀察時間 duration 從 120 改成 132 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 72 變為 79.2 persons。先說明「月台旅客積壓」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only observation duration duration from 120 to 132 s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 72 to 79.2 persons. Explain the causal direction for passenger accumulation at platforms, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 實績時刻對齊~Aligning recorded operating times
units.title: 實績時刻對齊~Aligning recorded operating times
units.mechanism: 本單元核對車站與列車記錄的時基，避免把系統時間偏差當作需要調整的時刻衝突。時鐘頻率偏差會隨時間累積成時間差，校時瞬間的偏移與之不同。多系統事件排序若依不同時鐘，可能把因果順序顛倒；校時跳變又會使量測區間長度失真，所以需記錄時鐘品質與校正事件。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定頻率偏差的線性累積，忽略溫度漂移與校時伺服動態。~Check clocks in station and train records so timebase offset is not misidentified as a timetable conflict requiring intervention. Clock frequency error accumulates into time offset and differs from initial synchronization offset. Ordering multisystem events on different clocks can reverse apparent causality. Synchronization jumps can distort interval lengths, so clock quality and correction events must be recorded. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Linear accumulation at fixed frequency offset; temperature drift and synchronization-servo dynamics are omitted.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：時鐘頻率偏差 drift=20 ppm；未校時期間 duration=3600 s。公式 y=drift*1e-6*duration，代入得 y=0.072 s。邊界：固定頻率偏差的線性累積，忽略溫度漂移與校時伺服動態。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: clock frequency offset drift=20 ppm; unsynchronized interval duration=3600 s. Formula y=drift*1e-6*duration gives y=0.072 s. Boundary: Linear accumulation at fixed frequency offset; temperature drift and synchronization-servo dynamics are omitted.
units.verify: 用獨立時間基準比較多個時刻的偏移，從斜率分辨頻率誤差與一次性跳變。以「實績時刻對齊」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Compare offsets at several times against an independent reference, using slope to distinguish frequency error from a one-time jump. For aligning recorded operating times, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 只對齊開始時刻卻忽略頻率漂移，會讓長測試中的事件逐漸錯位，並誤判通訊延遲。回到「實績時刻對齊」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Aligning only the initial instant leaves frequency drift uncorrected, progressively misaligning events and suggesting false network delay. Trace the input chain for aligning recorded operating times. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 測試開始時時鐘一致就能保證整天時間戳都一致~Clocks aligned at test start remain aligned for the entire day.
units.practice: 只把未校時期間 duration 從 3600 改成 3960 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.072 變為 0.0792 s。先說明「實績時刻對齊」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only unsynchronized interval duration from 3600 to 3960 s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.072 to 0.0792 s. Explain the causal direction for aligning recorded operating times, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.title: 衝突優先權狀態~Conflict-priority states
units.mechanism: 本單元列舉讓行、等待與資源保留的抽象狀態，檢查局部決策是否形成循環等待。布林狀態組合隨變數個數指數成長，這說明逐一人工檢查很快失去效率。可達性約束能排除不可能組合，但刪除條件必須有證據；安全性質通常針對所有可達狀態，而非幾個畫面上看起來合理的狀態。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：未限制的布林笛卡兒積；實際可達狀態通常較少，但需另證明。~Enumerate abstract yield, wait and reservation states to check whether local decisions create a circular wait. Boolean combinations grow exponentially with variable count, explaining why manual enumeration soon becomes ineffective. Reachability constraints can eliminate impossible combinations, but each exclusion needs justification. Safety properties normally concern every reachable state rather than a few states that look plausible on a display. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Unconstrained Boolean Cartesian product; actual reachability can be smaller but must be established separately.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：布林變數數量 bits=8 bits。公式 y=2**bits，代入得 y=256 states。邊界：未限制的布林笛卡兒積；實際可達狀態通常較少，但需另證明。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: number of Boolean state variables bits=8 bits. Formula y=2**bits gives y=256 states. Boundary: Unconstrained Boolean Cartesian product; actual reachability can be smaller but must be established separately.
units.verify: 用小型模型列舉轉移，再與需求允許的轉移表比較，對被排除狀態留下理由。以「衝突優先權狀態」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Enumerate transitions in a small model, compare against the required transition table, and document reasons for excluded states. For conflict-priority states, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 把感測器故障狀態預先刪掉會讓證明失去關鍵邊界，狀態抽象過粗也可能隱藏時序競爭。回到「衝突優先權狀態」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Excluding sensor-fault states can remove the crucial boundary from a proof; overly coarse abstraction may hide timing races. Trace the input chain for conflict-priority states. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 狀態變數多一個只會多出一種狀態組合~Adding one Boolean state variable creates only one additional combination.
units.practice: 只把布林變數數量 bits 從 8 改成 9 bits（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 256 變為 512 states。先說明「衝突優先權狀態」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only number of Boolean state variables bits from 8 to 9 bits (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 256 to 512 states. Explain the causal direction for conflict-priority states, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 擾動情境覆蓋~Coverage of disruption scenarios
units.title: 擾動情境覆蓋~Coverage of disruption scenarios
units.mechanism: 本單元把單點晚到、多點晚到與折返失效分開測試，避免以正常日重播代表所有調度情境。測試覆蓋率只對已定義的分母有意義。需求、狀態、轉移與危害各有不同分母，執行很多正常案例仍可能漏掉罕見但重要的交接；同一案例重跑多次不會自動增加獨立需求的覆蓋。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。~Test isolated delay, multiple delays and failed reversal separately rather than treating normal-day replay as representative of every dispatch scenario. Coverage is meaningful only relative to its defined denominator. Requirements, states, transitions and hazards have different denominators. Many normal cases can still omit a rare but important handoff, and repeating one case does not automatically cover additional independent requirements. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：已執行案例 tested=72 cases；已定義案例 total=90 cases。公式 y=tested/total，代入得 y=0.8 1。邊界：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: executed cases tested=72 cases; defined cases total=90 cases. Formula y=tested/total gives y=0.8 1. Boundary: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure.
units.verify: 建立需求到案例的一對多追溯表，將未測、失敗與不適用分開，抽查原始證據。以「擾動情境覆蓋」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Build requirement-to-case traceability, separate untested, failed and inapplicable cases, and sample raw evidence. For coverage of disruption scenarios, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 縮小分母可讓覆蓋率看似提高，重複案例也可能掩蓋邊界狀態根本未被執行。回到「擾動情境覆蓋」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Shrinking the denominator makes coverage look better; duplicate cases can hide boundary states that were never exercised. Trace the input chain for coverage of disruption scenarios. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險~One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk.
units.practice: 只把已執行案例 tested 從 72 改成 73 cases（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.8 變為 0.811111 1。先說明「擾動情境覆蓋」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only executed cases tested from 72 to 73 cases (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.8 to 0.811111 1. Explain the causal direction for coverage of disruption scenarios, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.title: 時刻重播工作量~Timetable-replay effort
units.mechanism: 本單元規畫多個需求水準與擾動組合的重播，保留初始列車位置和旅客需求以利比較。測試工時包含案例執行與環境設定、資料復原及證據整理。平行化只有在資源和狀態真正獨立時有效；把多個會修改同一狀態的測試同時執行，可能造成結果不可重現，表面節省時間卻增加診斷成本。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：確定平均案例時間的串行估算，未含故障重測與資源衝突。~Plan replay over demand levels and disruption combinations, retaining initial train positions and passenger demand for meaningful comparison. Test effort includes case execution, setup, state restoration and evidence handling. Parallelism helps only when resources and state are genuinely independent. Concurrent tests modifying one shared state can become irreproducible, apparently saving execution time while increasing diagnostic cost. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Serial estimate with deterministic mean case time; failure reruns and resource conflicts are excluded.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：測試案例數 cases=120 cases；平均案例時間 minutes=8 min/case；設定與恢復時間 setup=180 min。公式 y=(cases*minutes+setup)/60，代入得 y=19 h。邊界：確定平均案例時間的串行估算，未含故障重測與資源衝突。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: test cases cases=120 cases; mean case duration minutes=8 min/case; setup and recovery time setup=180 min. Formula y=(cases*minutes+setup)/60 gives y=19 h. Boundary: Serial estimate with deterministic mean case time; failure reruns and resource conflicts are excluded.
units.verify: 逐案記錄前置狀態、執行時間與復原時間，分開列出正常完成和失敗重測。以「時刻重播工作量」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Record preconditions, execution and restoration for every case, separating normal completion from failure reruns. For timetable-replay effort, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 省略復原步驟會讓前案狀態污染後案，僅報告成功案例時間則低估總測試成本。回到「時刻重播工作量」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Omitted restoration contaminates later tests with earlier state; reporting only successful durations understates total effort. Trace the input chain for timetable-replay effort. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 所有整合測試都可以同時執行而完全不影響結果~All integration tests can run simultaneously without affecting results.
units.practice: 只把測試案例數 cases 從 120 改成 121 cases（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 19 變為 19.1333 h。先說明「時刻重播工作量」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only test cases cases from 120 to 121 cases (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 19 to 19.1333 h. Explain the causal direction for timetable-replay effort, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 穩健時刻證據限制~Evidence limits for robust timetables
units.title: 穩健時刻證據限制~Evidence limits for robust timetables
units.mechanism: 本單元檢查零衝突模擬是否來自有限擾動集合，將可行性結論限制在已驗證的假設範圍。零次觀察到失效不代表真實失效機率為零。獨立伯努利試驗可由全數成功的機率反推單側上界，試驗數增加才會縮小界限；相關測試或只選容易案例會使這個統計推論不再成立，也不能由此宣告達到安全完整性等級。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：獨立同分布二元試驗且觀察零失效，非每小時失效率。~Examine whether conflict-free simulations cover only a limited disruption set, bounding feasibility claims by the assumptions actually tested. Zero observed failures does not imply zero true failure probability. Independent Bernoulli trials allow a one-sided upper bound from the probability of all successes, which decreases with sample count. Correlated or selectively easy cases invalidate this inference and cannot establish a safety-integrity level. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Independent identical binary trials with zero observed failures, not an hourly failure rate.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：獨立試驗次數 tests=300 independent trials；單側信賴水準 confidence=0.95 1。公式 y=1-(1-confidence)**(1/tests)，代入得 y=0.00993608 failure probability。邊界：獨立同分布二元試驗且觀察零失效，非每小時失效率。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: independent trial count tests=300 independent trials; one-sided confidence level confidence=0.95 1. Formula y=1-(1-confidence)**(1/tests) gives y=0.00993608 failure probability. Boundary: Independent identical binary trials with zero observed failures, not an hourly failure rate.
units.verify: 核對案例獨立性與抽樣範圍，保留所有失敗紀錄，再說明統計界限對哪一類情境有效。以「穩健時刻證據限制」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Audit independence and sampling scope, retain all failures, and state the scenario population to which the bound applies. For evidence limits for robust timetables, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 反覆重跑相同狀態可能沒有增加獨立證據，刪去失敗案例則直接破壞零失效假設。回到「穩健時刻證據限制」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Repeated identical states may add no independent evidence, while deleting failures invalidates the zero-failure assumption. Trace the input chain for evidence limits for robust timetables. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 完成很多次沒有故障的測試就能證明故障機率為零~Many failure-free tests prove that the failure probability is zero.
units.practice: 只把獨立試驗次數 tests 從 300 改成 301 independent trials（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.00993608 變為 0.00990324 failure probability。先說明「穩健時刻證據限制」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only independent trial count tests from 300 to 301 independent trials (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.00993608 to 0.00990324 failure probability. Explain the causal direction for evidence limits for robust timetables, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

教學假設：月台旅客積壓採 arrival=3.2 persons/s；本課公式結果 72 persons，非現場額定值。~Teaching assumption for passenger accumulation at platforms: arrival=3.2 persons/s; this model gives 72 persons, not a field rating.
教學假設：實績時刻對齊採 drift=20 ppm；本課公式結果 0.072 s，非現場額定值。~Teaching assumption for aligning recorded operating times: drift=20 ppm; this model gives 0.072 s, not a field rating.
